source: Ah... reality is full of possibilities. Every choice we make creates alternate universes. There are endless events and outcomes in this quantum soup we call the multiverse... and yet you've somehow exhausted them. Welcome to the the nothingness. Not much to do, really.
target: 摆... 现实充满了各种可能性。 我们所做的每一个选择 都创造了不同的宇宙。 量子汤里有无尽的事件和结果 我们称之为多相... 而你却不知怎么地让他们筋疲力尽 欢迎来到虚无之地 真的没什么可做的
